theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (G : ℝ × ℝ → Euclid P) (R : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (h : Euclid P → ℝ), MeasurableSet R → (∀ q ∈ R, DifferentiableAt ℝ G q) → (∀ q ∈ R, Injective (fderiv ℝ G q)) → InjOn G R → ∫ x in G '' R, h x ∂μHE[2] = ∫ q in R, Real.sqrt (‖fderiv ℝ G q (1, 0)‖ ^ 2 * ‖fderiv ℝ G q (0, 1)‖ ^ 2 - inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G q (1, 0)) (fderiv ℝ G q (0, 1)) ^ 2) * h (G q)
